'''Something Suspicious''' (Japanese: '''ケルディオ II''' ''Keldeo II''), titled '''VS Keldeo II''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 519th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 59th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}.

It is subtitled '''Keldeo''' (Japanese: '''狩人''' ''Hunter'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Something Suspicious''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation.

==Plot==
Continuing their battle against the [[Shadow Triad]], [[Chili]], [[Cress]] and [[Cilan]] take offense at the suggestion that they have to defend [[Striaton Gym]] as a trio due to weakness. To the Triad's surprise, the triplets put up a fierce resistance despite their initial disadvantage. Recalling [[Lenora]] and her kind words, the Striaton leaders reaffirm their role to educate new Trainers on type advantages, and taunt their opponents. The Shadow Triad realizes that the brothers weren't at the [[Nacrene Museum]] precisely so they could track them down; the Striaton leaders add that they were also searching for [[Evolution stones]] to evolve their Pokémon,  With Pansear, Panpour and Pansear evolved into their final forms, the brothers continue pushing on.

Atop a cliff, the {{adv|Swords of Justice}} arrive to witness the battle. When {{p|Keldeo}} asks which side is in the right, {{p|Cobalion}} coldly responds that neither side is in the right, as human battles are about rejecting each other. Through its own observations, Keldeo reasons that while the Shadow Triad is stronger, their Pokémon aren't giving their best in the battle as if afraid of being abused if they fail; conversely, the Striaton Gym Leaders have a stronger bond with their Pokémon and enjoying the fight. Keldeo also senses an ominous aura from the nearby [[P2 Laboratory]] and that the Shadow Triad shares the same mysterious feel. Deciding that the Gym Leaders are on the side of good, Keldeo jumps into the fight and pleads for permission from its masters to intervene. With its masters' blessing, Keldeo easily knocks back the Shadow Triad and their Pokémon.

Satisfied, Keldeo prepares to leave, but is caught up by the Shadow Triad's {{p|Lilligant}} and its {{m|Grass Knot}}. The Shadow Triad make a move to capture Keldeo, prompting the Striaton brothers to protect Keldeo, but both sides are stopped when the other Swords of Justice step in. The three Pokémon commend Keldeo's {{m|Secret Sword}} but Cobalion informs Keldeo that it has one more sword to wield: "Resolution". Despite the Striaton trio's attempt to fall back, Cobalion, {{p|Terrakion}} and {{p|Virizion}} launch a powerful {{m|Sacred Sword}} that sends everyone flying.

Warning the humans to never intervene again, Cobalion prepares to depart. The Shadow Triad laments their loss and attribute it to no longer having the {{adv|forces of nature}} under their command. One of the Triad decides to use their {{p|Genesect|secret weapon}} to punish the Swords of Justice as a sign of their power, and uses it to launch a blast attack at Keldeo as its group travels over the sea. Before Keldeo is hit, its seniors intercept the attack. To Keldeo's horror, its seniors are frozen in ice and plunge into the water, sinking to the seabed.

==Major events==
* [[Cilan]], [[Chili]], and [[Cress]] continue their battle with the [[Shadow Triad]], who evolve their {{TP|Cilan|Pansage}}, {{TP|Chili|Pansear}}, and {{p|Panpour}} into {{p|Simisage}}, {{p|Simisear}}, and {{p|Simipour}} to gain an advantage.
* The {{adv|Swords of Justice}} arrive and witness the battle.
* {{p|Keldeo}} decides the [[Gym Leader]]s are on the side of good and jumps in to stop the Shadow Triad.
* The Shadow Triad attempt to capture [[Kelden|Keldeo]], but are stopped by {{DL|Swords of Justice (Adventures)|Cobalion}}, {{DL|Swords of Justice (Adventures)|Terrakion}}, and {{DL|Swords of Justice (Adventures)|Virizion}}.
* {{p|Cobalion}} tells Keldeo that it has one more sword and the key to obtaining it is "Resolution".
* Cobalion, {{p|Terrakion}}, and {{p|Virizion}} defeat both the Striaton Gym Leaders and the Shadow Triad.
* As the Swords of Justice leave, the Shadow Triad unleash {{p|Genesect|their secret weapon}} on the quartet.
* Keldeo is almost hit by the weapon's attack, but is protected by its three seniors, who are frozen and sink into the waters below.

==Trivia==
* The magazine version of this chapter does not feature the scenes where {{DL|Swords of Justice (Adventures)|Cobalion}}, {{DL|Swords of Justice (Adventures)|Terrakion}} and {{DL|Swords of Justice (Adventures)|Virizion}} are frozen and fall into the water. Instead, it features a scene where [[Cilan]], [[Chili]] and [[Cress]] decide to forfeit their Gym Leader roles.
* In the VIZ mini-volume release, this chapter's title was '''Triple Threat'''.
* The English title in the VIZ Media volume version shares the same English title as [[PS517]] that takes place two chapters earlier.
